uncited: It builds on [Dynamic MLP Maps](7360-dynamic-mlp-maps.md) by replacing the direct feature lookup with hash encoding to improve spatial resolution and detail capture, while maintaining the efficiency of the CNN-decoded parameter maps.
**MLP Maps:** Three 2D grids (axis-aligned orthogonal planes: XY, YZ, XZ).
Each cell stores parameters for a shallow MLP.
The parameters are predicted by a shared 2D CNN decoder conditioned on a per-frame latent code.
**Hash Tables:** Multi-level hash tables mapping 3D coordinates to high-dimensional feature vectors.
